change.execution_order: After each captured Copy/Convert draw to the destination image, apply the captured clear over the exact source Copy rectangle on that operation's source EDRAM attachment before the next ordered operation.
change.supported_color_clear: Both captured raw color-clear values must be available and equal zero. The clear shader writes zero to enabled color channels.
change.supported_depth_stencil_clear: The source must be D24S8 and the captured raw value must be 0xFFFFFF00, decoded as depth 1.0 and stencil 0. The depth test is ALWAYS with writes enabled; stencil compares ALWAYS, replaces on pass, and writes all bits.
change.geometry: Requires the Copy/Convert packet's captured rectangle vertex/geometry shaders, guest rectangle geometry, and source raster scissor. The clear does not substitute a fullscreen draw.
change.fail_closed: Rejects incomplete clear registers, unsupported raw values, missing captured rectangle geometry, missing clear SPIR-V, and depth clear on other source depth formats before queue submission.
change.vulkan: Uses Vulkan 1.1 render passes and explicit color/depth image and host-buffer barriers.

retail_capture_reference.sequence: 14-draw transition capture includes a format-26 all-four-sample Copy/Convert with color and depth clear enabled, followed by seven format-31 sample-zero color-clearing copies.
retail_capture_reference.limits: Register values specify this captured subset; they do not prove the full transition's source-layout association or successful execution.

regressions.format_26: Synthetic 4x source executes format-26 Copy/Convert with color and D24S8 depth/stencil clear enabled under the Vulkan validation layer; converted destination values remain exact.
regressions.format_31: Synthetic format-31 source executes color-only clear; an ordered cached-source Copy/Convert followed by a presenter copy reads back zero from the persisted exact-layout EDRAM target.
regressions.classification: Synthetic Vulkan renderer regression, not retail framebuffer parity. The test does not independently read back D24S8 planes to compare the cleared depth/stencil bits.
